title: Firecrawl for Platforms
snippet:
Firecrawl for Platforms lets your platform create and manage Firecrawl API keys for your users directly from your own backend. Your users can then search, scrape, and interact with the web through Firecrawl, the context API for AI agents, without leaving your platform.
Set up Firecrawl for Platforms yourself in the [Firecrawl dashboard](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api). Any admin or member of an organization can create an integration: name it, choose an integration type, accept the agreement for that type, and copy the platform key. The key is shown once. You can mint and revoke keys later under Settings. No application or approval is needed.
There are two integration types. Both provision accounts the same way through the endpoints below, with the same platform key; they differ in who pays for the user’s usage:
- **Standard**: your users pay Firecrawl. Each provisioned account keeps its own Firecrawl plan and billing and upgrades with Firecrawl directly. See Credits for provisioned accounts for what a new account starts with.
- **Gateway**: your organization funds your users. Accounts your integration creates are enrolled in Gateway, so their eligible usage bills to your organization. See Gateway below.
You choose the integration type when you create the integration. It is not easy to change afterwards, so we recommend reviewing both options carefully before you accept the agreement. See the [Firecrawl for Platforms page](https://www.firecrawl.dev/firecrawl-for-platforms) for an overview. Some partner offers include promotional credits for provisioned users; when they do, [Partner Credits](/partner-credits) describes what the user receives.

Authentication
All Platforms API requests require an `Authorization` header with your platform key:
```
Authorization: Bearer <platform key>
```
Platform keys are distinct from standard Firecrawl API keys. You create and revoke them under Settings > Firecrawl for Platforms in the [Firecrawl dashboard](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api).
##
​
Security Requirements
- **Server-side only**: Platform keys must only be used in server-side code. Never expose a platform key in frontend code, client-side JavaScript, or mobile applications.
- **Terms of Service**: Before calling `POST /partner/v1/accounts`, your platform must prompt the user to accept Firecrawl’s [Terms of Service](https://www.firecrawl.dev/terms-of-service).

title: Partner Credits
snippet:
The standard partner offer may include **10,000 free Firecrawl credits**. These credits let you use any Firecrawl endpoint, including [Search](/features/search), [Scrape](/features/scrape), [Crawl](/features/crawl), [Map](/features/map), [Interact](/features/interact), and more.

If you’d like to offer Firecrawl to your users, set up Firecrawl for Platforms yourself in the [Firecrawl dashboard](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api). The [Firecrawl for Platforms page](https://www.firecrawl.dev/firecrawl-for-platforms) explains the two integration types and the [reference](/firecrawl-for-platforms) covers the endpoints.

title: Rate Limits
snippet:
### Keyless (no API key)
The hosted Firecrawl MCP keyless endpoint exposes exactly **Search, Scrape, and Parse** without an API key. Other hosted MCP tools require an account connection or an API key. For official Firecrawl clients, the CLI, SDKs, and REST API, keyless access also includes **Interact**. On Firecrawl Cloud, research, developer, and government search endpoints can also be used without an API key. No other endpoints (crawl, extract, map, batch scrape, etc.) are available without a key. Keyless usage is free and capped per IP address per day by **two limits**, and exceeding either returns a `429`:
- A maximum number of **requests** per day.
- A maximum number of **credits** per day. Operations cost different amounts of credits (for example, Interact and JSON extraction cost more than a basic scrape), so heavier usage reaches the credit cap sooner.
[Sign up for a free API key](https://firecrawl.dev) to get 1,000 credits and higher rate limits at no cost — official clients automatically use your key once it’s configured.
### Current Plans
| Plan | /scrape | /map | /crawl | /search | /agent | /crawl/status | /agent/status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | 10 | 10 | 2 | 10 | 2 | 500 | 500 |
| Hobby | 100 | 100 | 20 | 100 | 20 | 5000 | 5000 |
| Standard | 500 | 500 | 100 | 500 | 100 | 25000 | 25000 |
| Growth | 5000 | 5000 | 1000 | 5000 | 1000 | 250000 | 250000 |
| Scale | 10000 | 10000 | 2000 | 10000 | 2000 | 500000 | 500000 |

title: Partner Program | Firecrawl
snippet:
Firecrawl for Platforms
# Firecrawl Partner Program
For platforms that provision Firecrawl accounts for their users. Grow with us, and share in the revenue from the users you bring.
## What approved partners get
- Revenue shareA share of paid usage from the users you bring.
- Co-marketingJoint launches and a listing in our partner directory.
- Early accessTry new endpoints before they ship.
- A direct line to our teamTechnical support from the people who build Firecrawl.
- Higher limitsMore headroom for the users you provision.
What we ask in returnDisplay "Powered by Firecrawl" in your product, linking to firecrawl.dev with your ?ref=<partner> tag.
Apply and we'll email you next steps right away: create your integration in the dashboard and add a card to verify it.
Rev share applies only to new paying customers you refer after your application is approved, never retroactively. Our team reaches out to larger partners about co-marketing.
## Apply
Tell us about your product and how your users reach Firecrawl.
Trouble with the form? Email [partnerships@firecrawl.dev](mailto:partnerships@firecrawl.dev).

snippet:
Partner API access is **only available to approved Firecrawl partners**. Partner keys are shared privately with approved partners. To apply for the partner program or request a partner API key, email [partnerships@firecrawl.dev](mailto:partnerships@firecrawl.dev).
For details on what partner users receive, including credits, expiration, and plan limits, see [Partner Credits](/firecrawl/firecrawl-docs/blob/main/partner-credits).
## Base URL
```
https://integrations.firecrawl.dev
```
## Authentication
All Partner Integration API requests require an `Authorization` header with your partner key:
```
Authorization: Bearer < partner key >
```
Partner keys are distinct from standard Firecrawl API keys and are provided directly by the Firecrawl team.
## Security Requirements
- **Server-side only**: Partner keys must only be used in server-side code. Never expose a partner key in frontend code, client-side JavaScript, or mobile applications.
- **Terms of Service**: Before calling `POST /partner/v1/accounts`, your platform must prompt the user to accept Firecrawl's [Terms of Service](https://www.firecrawl.dev/terms-of-service).

Firecrawl's partner program is available to approved platforms. If you're interested in integrating Firecrawl into your platform and offering credits to your users, contact us at [partnerships@firecrawl.dev](mailto:partnerships@firecrawl.dev) to learn more and request a partner API key.

title: firecrawl.dev/pricing.md
snippet:
### Free
- **Credits**: 1,000 per month
- **Price**: $0 (no credit card required)
- **Concurrency**: 2 concurrent requests
- **Rate limits**: Low rate limits
### Hobby
- **Credits**: 5,000 per month
- **Price**: $19/month or $16/month billed annually ($190/year, save $38)
- **Concurrency**: 5 concurrent requests
- **Support**: Basic support
### Standard (Recommended)
- **Credits**: 100,000 per month
- **Price**: $99/month or $83/month billed annually ($990/year, save $198)
- **Concurrency**: 25 concurrent requests
- **Support**: Standard support
### Growth
- **Credits**: 500,000 per month
- **Price**: $399/month or $333/month billed annually ($3,990/year, save $798)
- **Concurrency**: 50 concurrent requests
- **Support**: Priority support
